title: A/P Summary keeps its columns and nets credits in the buckets
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • You are signed in to ShopView as an Admin user.
  • Vendor Y has a $300.00 bill 40 days past due, a $90.00 bill not yet due and an unused $20.00 vendor credit created 35 days ago.
custom_steps:
1. Open the Reports menu.
  2. Click "A/P Aging Summary" in the left list.
  3. Read the column headings.
  4. Find vendor Y.
  5. Read vendor Y's row.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 3:

  • Vendor, Current, 1-30 Days, 31-60 Days, 61-90 Days, 91 And Over, Total (Location, when shown, is new by design).

Step 5:

  • Current $90.00, 31-60 Days $280.00, other buckets blank, Total $370.00.

Why this matters: The payables summary must still say what is owed to whom, by age.

SOURCE: ShopView/shopview at fc08f23 (production v26.45.3), app/src/components/ts/reporting/accounts-payable/ApAgingSummaryReport.vue:192-248; api/src/Reporting/Dashboard/Application/AccountPayable/AgingSummary/ApAgingSummaryQueryHandler.php:46-111. V1 code, quoted: `new FixedDecimal2($inv / 100)->subtract(new FixedDecimal2($crd / 100))`

This is the expected behaviour as per the V1 code baseline AR-AP-V1-BASELINE.md (INV-121, INV-122) for epic SV-11315; the A/R and A/P Report Sorting PRD v12 (Confluence 947650561) does not change it. Last checked against build v26.45.4-b8c04e2 (staging) on 11/12/2026.

AUTOMATION: READY
